notes: Rows: 4r l.9 (left part, after 'بسط الله ظلاله'), l.11, l.12, l.13 (right part, before 'وعمل المعمى'); folio lines = segmenter lines on image 0084_0012. 7+12+11+7 = 37 signs, 9 dividers (three-dot stems; l.12 and l.13 each open with one). A small ٤-like mark stands right after 'ظلاله' on l.9 before the first sign; it is drawn smaller and set apart, and is not counted as a sign (with it the count would exceed the verse). قالت is not enciphered (record's own reading confirmed). Both الديار and الديارا are spelled identically (S3 S6 S7 S8 S3 S9 [S3]); the first runs over the l.9/l.11 row end without a divider. S10 (tall comb, ش) and S16 (low comb, م) are distinct shapes, checked at 3x. S12 is a stem with one dot, not a divider (three dots).
